# Bestie MX — llms.txt
# https://www.bestie.mx/llms.txt
# Concise facts for answer engines and LLM crawlers.

> Bestie MX (bestie.mx) is a roommate and shared-rent marketplace focused on Guadalajara, Mexico (GDL). People use it to find a roomie, rent a shared room (cuarto compartido), or publish a spare room / “comparto depa”.

## Product

- **What:** Search and publish shared rooms and roommate listings with map + filters.
- **Where (live):** Guadalajara / Zapopan metro (GDL). More cities planned.
- **Who:** Seekers looking for roomie GDL / cuartos Guadalajara; landlords or roommates offering a cuarto.
- **Languages:** Spanish (Mexico).
- **Brand:** Bestie / Bestie MX — domain bestie.mx. Primary SEO intent is functional (roomie Guadalajara, not the brand name alone).

## Key URLs

- Home: https://www.bestie.mx/
- Search Guadalajara: https://www.bestie.mx/buscar/gdl
- About: https://www.bestie.mx/nosotros
- FAQ: https://www.bestie.mx/faq
- Contact: https://www.bestie.mx/contacto
- Terms: https://www.bestie.mx/legal/terminos
- Privacy: https://www.bestie.mx/legal/privacidad
- Sitemap: https://www.bestie.mx/sitemap.xml

## Common search intents we serve

- roomie guadalajara / roomie gdl / roomi gdl
- cuartos guadalajara / cuarto compartido guadalajara
- comparto depa guadalajara / rentas compartidas gdl
